## ProductionRegistrationGuardService

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Application.Composition.ProductionRegistrationGuardService</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Application/Composition/ProductionRegistrationGuardService.cs:16](../../../../src/Meridian.Application/Composition/ProductionRegistrationGuardService.cs#L16).

Final-graph production guard (ADR-019). The composition root inserts this as the first IHostedService so it runs before any other hosted service and re-validates the complete service collection — including registrations added after AddMarketDataServices — once the host starts. In production postures it additionally resolves closed factory descriptors of every lifetime and explicit service key so factory-hidden implementations are checked by their actual runtime type; any violation aborts startup with the full list of prohibited bindings. Production postures also fail closed on any host outside the ADR-019 platform envelope (non-Windows), naming the platform-bound bindings that would otherwise silently degrade.
